Currently leads the Data Science and Modeling team at Kapitalo, combining hands-on statistical modeling and technical leadership with the development of reliable analytical pipelines and data products. ## Areas of Expertise **Modeling:** Forecasting · Econometrics · Machine Learning · State-Space Models · Bayesian Inference **Data:** Alternative and Unstructured Data · High-Frequency Data · Web Data **Tools & Delivery:** R · Stan · Python · SQL · DuckDB · PostgreSQL · dbt · APIs · Git · Reproducible Pipelines · Automated Reporting · Dashboards · Web Applications ## Professional Experience ::: {.entry} ::: {.entry-header} ::: {.entry-title} ### Kapitalo Investimentos **Data Science & Economic Modeling Lead** ::: ::: {.meta} São Paulo, Brazil · 2022–Present ::: ::: - Lead the Data Science and Modeling team within Macroeconomic Research, providing technical direction, mentoring analysts, and overseeing the development of quantitative models and analytical products. - Design forecasting and nowcasting systems for economic variables using time-series methods, high-frequency indicators, and alternative data. - Develop statistical approaches for complex datasets characterized by changing predictors, mixed frequencies, missing observations, and continuously evolving coverage. - Transform web, textual, and other unstructured sources into structured indicators and model inputs for research and decision-making. - Build and maintain end-to-end analytical workflows, including data collection, databases, model estimation, automated reporting, dashboards, and internal applications. - Collaborate with economists and investment professionals to translate open-ended research questions into reliable and interpretable quantitative solutions. ::: ::: {.entry} ::: {.entry-header} ::: {.entry-title} ### Itaú Asset Management **Quantitative Research Analyst** ::: ::: {.meta} São Paulo, Brazil · 2019–2022 ::: ::: - Developed quantitative models, indicators, and forecasting tools for macroeconomic and financial research. - Applied time-series and econometric methods to extract signals from noisy, incomplete, and high-frequency data. - Integrated alternative datasets into recurring macroeconomic and investment research workflows. - Communicated model results and analytical findings to economists and investment professionals. ::: ::: {.entry} ::: {.entry-header} ::: {.entry-title} ### IPEDF **Economic Research Analyst** ::: ::: {.meta} Brasília, Brazil · 2017–2019 ::: ::: - Conducted applied economic research and monitored regional economic activity using official and administrative data. - Developed statistical indicators and analytical tools to measure economic conditions and support public-policy discussions. - Produced reports and presented quantitative findings to technical and nontechnical audiences. ::: ## Education **M.S. in Economics**, Universidade Federal Fluminense · 2017 **B.S. in Economics**, Universidade Federal Fluminense · 2013 ## Publication Author of [*R for Economic Research*](https://book.rleripio.com), a practical guide to data workflows, statistical modeling, time series, and forecasting for applied research. The book has received more than 50,000 views from readers in over 50 countries. ## Selected Presentations - **Nowcasting When Predictors Keep Changing: Leveraging Cross-Sectional Information in High-Dimensional, High-Turnover Data** — International Symposium on Forecasting · Montreal · 2026 - **Nowcasting Inflation in Brazil Using Web Data** — International Symposium on Forecasting · Charlottesville · 2023 - **Real-Time Forecasting of COVID-19 Cases Across US Regions** — International Symposium on Forecasting · Remote · 2020 :::
